title: Publish plan
description: Writes that publish --plan proposes for one change request. publish --apply executes exactly these actions, from plans whose SHA-256 is the one recorded in state.json, and writes nothing for a change request whose head commit is no longer headSha. Nothing is written without a confirmed plan.

cr.description: Change request the plan writes to.

headSha.description: Head commit the plan was made for.

publish.description: What the user asked to publish: comments (the inline comments, the note that nothing blocks and the Related Changes tick), issues, or both.

actions.description: Writes in the order they are executed. An empty list means there is nothing to publish.

items.description: One write. What each kind needs is in the rules below.

id.description: Number of the action, from 1, in the order the actions are executed. Ids never change once the plan is written; publish --apply executes all of them.

kind.description: review-comment is an inline comment, in the one review of the change request; summary-comment is the general note that says nothing blocks; issue-create opens an issue; issue-update rewrites the body of an open issue; label-create creates the label the issues use; related-tick ticks the entry of this change request in the Related Changes of its parent.

body.description: Text to post, in Markdown; it is secret-scanned before it is sent. Empty for label-create and related-tick.

findingId.description: Fingerprint of the finding an inline comment publishes: the id of a reported finding.

fingerprint.description: Fingerprint embedded in a summary-comment, an issue-create or an issue-update: the one that finds the text again.

severity.description: Severity of the findings of an inline comment or an issue.

rules.description: Rule id of each finding the action publishes, in the order of the text, for the summary the plan prints.

side.description: Diff side of an inline comment.

line.description: Last line of an inline comment.

startLine.description: First line of a multi-line inline comment; only with a suggestion.

project.description: Project of an issue or a label.

number.description: Number of the issue an issue-update rewrites.

assignee.description: Login of the author of the change request, whom a new issue is assigned to if the platform lets it; absent when the author is not known.

color.description: Colour of the label, six hexadecimal digits.

parent.description: Change request whose Related Changes entry a related-tick ticks.

entry.description: Related Changes entry a related-tick ticks: the change request this plan is for.

skipped.description: What the plan does not write and why, in the order it was found.

items.description: Something the plan does not write, or notes about what it found. An ignored-untrusted entry does not stop its action.

kind.description: The kind of action that was not planned.

findingId.description: Fingerprint of the finding that is not written.

target.description: What the entry is about when it is not a finding: a fingerprint, a change request key or a project key.

path.description: File the finding is in, for the summary the plan prints.

pattern.description: Name of the secret pattern that matched; never the text that matched.

detail.description: What else the reader needs, in one line.

line.description: Line number, starting at 1, in the file version of the chosen side.

relativePath.description: Relative path with forward slashes, without empty, '.' or '..' segments.

runId.description: Identifier of a review run, also the name of its work directory.

sha.description: Full commit SHA, 40 lowercase hexadecimal characters.

side.description: Side of the diff: LEFT is the target branch version, RIGHT the change request version.

timestamp.description: UTC time in RFC 3339 format, for example 2026-11-02T10:15:00Z.

status.description: Why something is not written, or what the platform answered. already-posted: a trusted fingerprint is already on the change request or issue. ignored-untrusted: a fingerprint was found, written by an account that is not trusted, so it does not count and the write goes ahead. head-changed: the change request has new commits since it was reviewed. not-open: the change request is closed or merged. own-cr: the change request was opened by the account of the token, so nothing is written. rejected: the platform refused the position of an inline comment. secret-blocked: a text matches a secret pattern. too-long: a body is longer than the platform accepts. not-eligible: the Related Changes entry cannot be ticked, and detail says why. no-anchor: a BLOCKER of the change request that no line of the diff can carry, so it stays in the report.

fingerprint.description: A fingerprint embedded in the text of an action: acr:v1: followed by what it identifies.

issueSeverity.description: Severity of a finding that is published: BLOCKER inline or in the issue of existing code, MAJOR and MINOR in issues.
